notes: Contract overrides UI copy and author handoff.
Helper bindings are partial; every full scenario remains unverified.
Dedicated backup scenarios are excluded from legacy generic sweeps.

cases.title: Stamp and owner page smoke
assertions: Match the live sidebar to the exact required stamp before any live test; record observed stamp separately from source pin.
Owner Backup page loads; an existing prepared pair is not proof of export or restore.

cases.title: Fresh primary Owner identity
assertions: Sign out and explicitly log in as a normal primary Owner; record alias, loaded role and tenant context without secrets.
Backup read/write work for Owner; a platform super-admin session alone does not establish normal Owner access.

cases.title: Viewer cannot read or write backup
assertions: Fresh Viewer cannot see or use Backup; directly exercise page and all prepare/download/restore/restore-files routes with real owned and foreign fixture records.
Copied grants, extra Owner job and allow-overrides do not confer backup access; denied requests leave DB, business audit and S3 unchanged.

cases.title: Company Admin cannot acquire owner-only backup
assertions: Test company Admin with RBAC on and off, extra Owner job, copied backup grants and allow-overrides; resolver, navigation and actual server denial are separate evidence.
Primary Owner positive control passes; Admin direct export/download/data/files requests deny with zero business mutations, even if UI is hidden.

cases.title: Control Room requires platform super-admin
assertions: Platform super-admin sees Overview, Companies, Modules, Access and ERP Health Check; normal company Admin and Owner do not gain these from company jobs.
Fresh non-platform sessions cannot directly load protected routes/actions; a nav helper pass is not server authorization proof.

cases.title: Password and confirmation validation
assertions: Test missing, 7-character, mismatched confirmation and over-128-character passwords; no prepared pair or business success audit is created.
At least 8 matching characters succeed; private password is never recorded in Git, screenshots, public logs or summaries.

cases.title: Paired encrypted downloads and checksums
assertions: Create and download both actual files; decrypt privately and independently compare exportId, schemaVersion 1 and cross-checksums against tables and object metadata.
Both downloads work and ciphertext differs for independent encryptions; extension/magic alone does not prove encryption or pair integrity.

cases.title: Tenant export isolation
assertions: Seed real foreign-tenant row and object sentinels; exported rows all belong to source A and tenant S3 pack excludes foreign objects and tenants/A/_archive/.
Verify isolation under the actual runtime DB role and prepared-download authorization; absence of nonexistent IDs is insufficient.

cases.title: Archive and telemetry omit secrets and operator data
assertions: Privately inspect actual decrypted payload for users/password_hash, other auth secrets, invites, ops logs and platform-only logs; none are included.
Check request logs, audit and stored prepare metadata do not retain the archive password; whitelist inspection alone does not certify actual export.

cases.title: Complete multi-business golden snapshot
assertions: Cover physical products/stock/layers, service/digital documents, rental events, POS, bank recon, settings and document templates with an independently recorded source ledger.
Export counts, quantities, money and relevant configuration match the source; test enabled/disabled modules and transformed references without weakening existing policies.

cases.title: Snapshot consistency during posting
assertions: In an isolated DB run controlled concurrent posting and export; snapshot is wholly before or after the committed transaction.
No half-journal, mismatched stock/settlement or foreign pooled tenant state; preserve timing/barrier evidence and both positive controls.

cases.title: Per-company prepare rate limit
assertions: One prepare per 120 seconds per company; attempt parallel owners, distinct workers and boundary times in isolation.
A second company remains independent; rejected prepare creates no extra usable pair and password values never become public evidence.

cases.title: Prepared download expiry and ownership
assertions: Test valid download before roughly 15-minute expiry, expired/missing token and wrong actor/tenant against actual routes.
Expired or unauthorized requests return no bytes; local metadata survives no longer than the documented validity and refreshed downloads do not extend access accidentally.

cases.title: All trading families enforce emptiness
assertions: For each of 14 non-voided trading families, independently seed a fresh isolated target and assert the real SQL emptiness predicate blocks restore.
Signup CoA/jobs/owner membership alone remain eligible; verify voided-row policy from the contract and do not reset a company to make it empty.

cases.title: Non-empty restore refusal
assertions: Restore source A into A and a separately traded target; require: This company already has records. Create a new company and restore into that.
Before/after DB, CoA, identity, business audit and S3 remain unchanged; owner authorization does not permit merge or overwrite.

cases.title: Wrong password and corrupt archive fail safely
assertions: Wrong password, altered ciphertext, truncation and invalid format refuse before target writes.
Target seed state and operational emptiness remain intact; error is usable and retry is possible without publishing payload/password.

cases.title: Schema kind checksum and compatibility gates
assertions: Data route rejects files kind, wrong checksums, malformed/unknown tables and future schema; v1 identity transformation preserves valid data.
No restore from newer archive into older app; old exports and missing metadata need explicit contract-compatible policy, not silently reduced validation.

cases.title: Real source A to empty B restore
assertions: Create a new empty company B through supported signup/create flow; restore A data in browser and verify persisted records through supported UI and isolated backend where available.
All PK/FK UUIDs are remapped consistently, target tenant differs, source unchanged, no foreign row or source tenant_id reused; helper remap is not this journey.

cases.title: Seed CoA jobs and document sequences
assertions: Restore replaces signup seed CoA/jobs as specified without duplicate account codes or orphaned roles; settings/templates remain usable.
Create the next supported document after restore; sequence uniqueness and references survive without editing stored IDs or resetting trading tables.

cases.title: Restorer ownership and teammate identity
assertions: Restorer remains the authenticated primary Owner in target B; extra archive users and their dependent membership/scope/team rows are skipped.
No teammate passwords/auth sessions are restored; invite teammates again through supported flow and verify future attribution.

cases.title: Independent accounting stock and subledger integrity
assertions: Compare independently expected debit=credit and trialBalanceHash before and after restore, not totals computed only by the implementation under test.
Verify per-document totals, AR/AP/settlements, stock quantities and cost-layer valuation; a balanced trial balance alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Failed restore rolls back completely
assertions: Inject invalid journals/FKs, stock-layer and AR/AP/document inconsistencies plus a mid-insert failure in an isolated DB.
Every failure preserves original seed CoA/jobs/owner and empty trading state; no success marker, partial audit or file applicability remains.

cases.title: Second data restore refused
assertions: After successful A to B data restore, repeat same or different data archive into B and require refusal.
Records, counts, sequence, owner and restore marker remain unchanged; first matching files pack is still allowed.

cases.title: Concurrent data restores serialize safely
assertions: Controlled simultaneous restores into one isolated eligible target permit at most one complete committed restore.
Losing request fails closed; no mixed UUID map, duplicated rows or mismatched restore marker; preserve real multi-connection evidence.

cases.title: Matching files restore and open real attachments
assertions: After data restore upload the matching files pack; inspect target object keys and privately compare byte hashes to source receipt and product/document image.
Open attachments through supported UI as the authorized target user; source owner and foreign user cannot use target receipt URLs.

cases.title: Data-only books and missing attachment UI
assertions: After data only, reports and books open with correct values; a tenants/ receipt lacking an object displays Missing attachment.
After matching pack apply, the same receipt opens and warning clears; missing object is not a leaked foreign object or a general storage outage.

cases.title: Pair mismatch prior-data and cross-checksum guards
assertions: No prior data restore, wrong exportId and wrong files/data cross-checksums refuse before storage writes.
Compare actual route behavior with pure guards; legacy data restore missing filesSha metadata is a contract question requiring explicit compatibility acceptance.

cases.title: Files pack applies at most once
assertions: A successful files application records the matching export once; replay refuses even if the filename is changed.
No duplicate writes/audit/success marker; partial failures do not masquerade as completed application.

cases.title: Fill missing objects without overwrite
assertions: Put a distinct target sentinel object before files apply; existing bytes/content type remain unchanged while missing valid objects are filled.
Use real MinIO and owner/non-owner controls; the in-memory store test is only partial evidence.

cases.title: Prefix-only storage identity rewrite
assertions: Only leading tenants/source/ becomes tenants/target/; retain old user and source-looking UUIDs within opaque suffix/filename.
Every stored reference resolves in target namespace; foreign or malformed prefix cannot be rewritten into an authorized target path.

cases.title: Large pack chunk boundary
assertions: Generate incompressible synthetic attachments so the encrypted pack is really over 8 MiB; upload in 4 MiB chunks and compare final hashes/counts.
Cover at/below 8 MiB and final short chunk; record actual byte sizes and upload method without publishing archives.

cases.title: Interrupted chunk and size protections
assertions: Exercise duplicate/out-of-order/missing chunks, cancelled upload, expired upload ID, foreign-owned upload ID and documented per-object/pack limits.
No premature files-applied marker, cross-tenant staging objects or unbounded leftovers; tunnel limit is an explicit skip, not a product pass.

cases.title: Invalid object paths and bytes
assertions: Traversal, backslash/NUL, foreign namespace, _archive internals and wrong object hashes cause no unsafe writes.
Invalid/skipped pack entries must not yield a false complete restore; count and integrity mismatch are visible and recoverable according to contract.

cases.title: Storage failure recovery
assertions: Simulate failed put after some objects in isolated storage; no false completion, lost existing bytes or unauthorized overwrite.
Retry fills only missing objects and audit accurately distinguishes partial from completed apply; do not assume S3 and DB form one transaction.

cases.title: Thirty-day reminder boundaries
assertions: Never exported and older than 30 days show reminder; test 29 days, exactly 30 and older than 30 using isolated clock fixtures.
Successful export updates reminder; no email cron is expected in v1 and restore is not silently treated as export.

cases.title: No prepared pair and real storage failure
assertions: Fresh eligible company Backup page loads with no latest.json/NoSuchKey; show usable empty state.
Genuine storage/auth/outage errors remain visible rather than silently claiming zero files; existing prepared pair does not prove this regression.

cases.title: withFormPending success and error cleanup
assertions: Helper emits pending before await and clears in finally on success and error, preserving returned value/error.
Run actual client DOM behavior separately; mocked window events do not prove timer, overlap or visible dismissal.

cases.title: Backup overlay dismisses promptly
assertions: Actual Create backup overlay may appear after 1.5 seconds; dismiss once operation/page is ready and both download controls remain usable.
No refresh needed; reaching the 45-second watchdog after work finished is a failure, not normal success.

cases.title: Reverse and login overlay regression
assertions: Fresh explicit login and supported reverse-one transaction journey complete without stuck overlay; preserve exactly one reversal and balanced net-zero journals.
Failed login/reverse also clears client pending; UI completion never substitutes for checking financial state or active identity.

cases.title: Invoice payment and conversion saves
assertions: Test server forms/shared Button and client async save paths for invoice, payment and quote conversion; overlay clears on success/error and controls re-enable.
Repeated clicks cannot double-post; verify document/journal/settlement counts and no unauthorised write regression.

cases.title: Filters search and cancel do not arm busy
assertions: Transaction GET filters, search, Cancel and non-submit buttons must not trigger global document submit capture or leave an overlay.
Use keyboard and repeated navigation; values/results remain usable without refresh and no writes occur.

cases.title: Delay watchdog and long operation semantics
assertions: Controlled short operation below 1.5 seconds has no flashing overlay; long operation shows it and maximum 45-second safeguard is observed.
Watchdog does not declare backend success, hide an error or enable duplicate financial writes; completed operation must dismiss before watchdog.

cases.title: Pathname unmount and shared form cleanup
assertions: Navigate/unmount during pending and test shared Button/useFormStatus cleanup; old pending event does not stick over a ready new page.
Check sequential and overlapping forms without duplicate writes; one operation ending must not falsely represent another unfinished operation.

cases.title: Accessible error retry and overlapping forms
assertions: After failed backup/login/save, error remains accessible, focus/keyboard reach retry and pending overlay dismisses.
Retry and concurrent client tasks preserve correct pending state and do not lose input or permit multiple financial commits.

cases.title: Mandatory unchanged core and physical regressions
assertions: Run all existing 60 source and 49 PostgreSQL cases on this exact new candidate with unchanged money/security expectations.
Fresh browser cash sale, Viewer denial, reverse once and fresh-company Backup load remain required; retain allocation/tender/date/SKU/atomicity/reserved-driver guards and do not reopen BUG-0010–0016.
